customer: Retired caller from Virginia selling his convertible rambled about his upcoming home pickup and his insurance renewal, then asked whether he could cancel his policy now to save some money.
agent: Customer asked about cancelling insurance before selling his convertible. Advised per 'When to cancel your insurance' that the car must stay insured until the sale is complete and the car is in our hands, including on the day of the home pickup, and that he should cancel or remove the car from his policy only after signing the paperwork. Suggested he ask his insurer about a refund for the unused part of his premium. Also reminded him to remove toll tags, garage codes and paired phones before handing over the car.
